subject: FinRivet security commitments & retention playbook
messages:
From: Maya Singh <maya.singh@finrivet.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwoodely.com>
Cc: procurement@finrivet.com
Date: Wed, 29 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Mutual close plan & security checklist

Rafael — thanks again for the demo yesterday. Procurement and security asked me to pull together an explicit mutual action plan so we can close the integration by the week of Oct 11. Before we lock dates, two immediate asks from our side: 

1) SOC 2 evidence: can you share the most recent attestation and whether the control owner list includes data residency / change management?
2) SIG/CAIQ: we've attached our questionnaire (FinRivet_Security_Questions_v2.xlsx). Can you complete the SIG-style rows that map to your hosted offering?
3) DPA: procurement would like an initial redline to review. Our preference is to keep retention and processing details explicit in the DPA.

Finally — a clear statement on default data retention for ephemeral inference inputs, embeddings, and logs would be helpful. Can Redwood provide standard options and recommended defaults?

Proposed timeline: we need evidence + redline by Oct 5 to remain on track. Is that feasible?

Thanks,
Maya Singh
Head of Security Programs
FinRivet

Attachment: FinRivet_Security_Questions_v2.xlsx

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwoodely.com>
To: Maya Singh <maya.singh@finrivet.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwoodely.com, neha_kapoor@redwoodely.com
Date: Wed, 29 Sep 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mutual close plan & security checklist

Maya — great to connect. Appreciate the clear list. Quick answers and next steps below. I've attached our SOC 2 attestation and a high-level SIG summary to accelerate mapping: Redwood_SOC2_Attestation_2027.pdf; Redwood_SIG_Summary.xlsx.

SOC 2: the attestation covers our hosted control plane and the inference runtime. Control owners for change management and data access are enumerated in the attestation appendix (see pages 6–8).

SIG/CAIQ: the summary spreadsheet marks the rows we can fully complete today and flags a handful where we need confirmatory evidence (3rd-party sub-processors, certain physical controls for Dedicated customers). We can complete the full CAIQ within 48 business hours once you confirm scope (hosted vs. dedicated).

DPA & retention: we will produce an initial DPA redline for your procurement team. Default options we support: 
- Inference inputs (requests): default retention 30 days (can be reduced to 0 on request or extended for auditing under explicit agreement).
- Embeddings/persistent artifacts: default 90 days; customers can opt for no retention or configure longer retention via account settings.
- Diagnostic logs/metrics: 180 days by default (aggregates only available longer-term).

Proposed action plan (short):
- Today: SOC2 attestation + SIG summary (attached)
- By Oct 1: Redwood to share DPA redline (legal: Laura) and a one-page retention options summary (security: Neha)
- By Oct 5: FinRivet reviews redline + SIG questions
- Week of Oct 11: DPA sign + kickoff SOW / provisioning

If these milestones work I can set a 30-minute call on Thursday to walk procurement through the DPA redline.

Thanks,
Rafael Mendes
Senior Account Executive — Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood_SOC2_Attestation_2027.pdf, Redwood_SIG_Summary.xlsx

From: Maya Singh <maya.singh@finrivet.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwoodely.com>
Cc: procurement@finrivet.com, Tim Owens <tim.owens@finrivet.com>
Date: Thu, 30 Sep 2027 08:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mutual close plan & security checklist

Thanks Rafael — documents received. A couple of clarifying Qs from our security and procurement leads: 

1) "Default retention 30 days for inference inputs" — does that include cached prefixes and KV cache persisted for optimization? Is that data encrypted at rest with separate customer keys or managed keys?
2) For embeddings: 90 days is acceptable, but would you consider a contractual option for 0 retention for PII-heavy use cases (we will take the performance tradeoffs)?
3) Procurement: can we get the DPA redline by Oct 1 as requested. If possible please include a short excerpt on audit rights and data location commitments.

Procurement (procurement@finrivet.com) — we're hoping to return the redline within 3 business days once we get it.

Appreciate the tempo — Maya

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwoodely.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwoodely.com, neha_kapoor@redwoodely.com
Date: Thu, 30 Sep 2027 09:01:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Mutual close plan & security checklist — action items

Team — forwarding FinRivet thread. Action items I need help with: 

- Laura: can you generate an initial DPA redline that makes retention explicit and includes a paragraph on audit rights (we typically allow SOC 2 report review + on-site audit coordination for enterprise contracts). Procurement wants that piece explicit.
- Neha: can you confirm the default behavior for cache/KV retention and encryption key ownership for hosted customers vs Dedicated? Also please draft a one-pager describing the performance implications of 0 retention for embeddings (we'll need to highlight throughput/latency tradeoffs).

Target dates: DPA redline by EOD Oct 1; retention one-pager by Oct 1 morning. FinRivet is leaning to a tight schedule so we should stick to it.

Thanks — Rafael

Subject: Re: DPA redline + retention options

Rafael / Maya — attaching the initial DPA redline (DPA_Redline_FinRivet_v1.docx). High level notes: 

- Retention: proposed default windows mirror what Rafael outlined (inputs = 30 days, embeddings = 90 days, logs = 180 days). We added explicit contract language allowing FinRivet to request a 0-day retention profile for embeddings/persistent artifacts; performance implications are called out in the appendix.
- Audit rights: Redwood will provide SOC 2 report access and support a reasonable on-site or virtual audit with at least 30 days notice. We included confidentiality scaffolding for shared evidence.
- Data location: for hosted accounts we commit to region-specific processing (US/EU as requested) and will list sub-processors. For Dedicated we flag that certain physical controls are vendor-managed and we will provide additional evidence on request.

Next steps: Neha to complete the SIG rows marked "security confirm" within 48 business hours. Once the SIG is complete and you confirm retention choice, we can push the DPA to DocuSign for signature.

Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel — Redwood Inference

Attachment: DPA_Redline_FinRivet_v1.docx
